summary: E2E for Phase H (Mega Menu), Phase I (Support Triage), Project Files (object storage) + full backend regression. 256/256 backend tests PASS (full suite ex-phase11/12/13/15/master). All 5 new pytests in test_project_files_and_triage.py PASS. Frontend mega menu (3 panels, links + featured CTAs), admin Support Triage, admin Project Files upload+download+delete, client /portal Files tab (auto-appears after upload), and mobile drawer all verified via Playwright. Two minor frontend issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: Filter input 'pf-list-filter' sends raw substring as client_email to backend which does exact-match (filt['client_email'] = client_email.lower().strip()). Typing 'testclient' returned 0 rows even though file existed for testclient@bybloomlabs.com. Either backend needs regex/prefix match or frontend should do client-side substring filtering.

data-testid 'pf-list' returned is_visible()=False from Playwright even though child pf-row-{id} cards render correctly. Likely the .space-y-2 wrapper has no measurable bbox in some layouts. Testing still works via child testids, but the documented testid contract should be honored.

action_items: Fix pf-list-filter UX: either change backend GET /admin/project-files to accept partial/regex client_email match, or do client-side substring filtering in ProjectFilesAdmin.jsx so the filter actually works for partial emails.
Verify pf-list testid wrapper renders with visible bbox (consider adding min-height or moving testid to a parent section).

rca of the issue: pf-list-filter: ProjectFilesAdmin.jsx line 61 sends lowercased trimmed string to backend client_email filter. Backend project_files_routes.py line 89 sets filt['client_email'] = exact value. Mongo find() therefore needs exact match. Fix: either change backend to {'client_email': {'$regex': value, '$options':'i'}} OR keep server-side exact match and add a client-side .filter(f => f.client_email.includes(filterEmail)) over the already-loaded list.
